业务背景

直签工程与工程服务费

深入解析箭牌工程渠道的业务模式与费用结算体系

<!-- 业务模式概述 -->
<section style="margin-bottom: 48px;">
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 24px;">
    
    <!-- 直营工程 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-4 mb-6">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <i class="fas fa-building"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 8px;">直营工程</h3>
          <span class="tag"><i class="fas fa-handshake"></i> 品牌直签</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p style="color: #6B7280; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 24px;">
        箭牌与工程方直接接洽并签订合同，没有中间第三方的介入，由箭牌完全对合同的履行负责的工程项目。
      </p>
      <div style="background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px;">
        <h4 style="font-weight: 600; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <i class="fas fa-star" style="color: #F59E0B;"></i> 核心特点
        </h4>
        <ul style="list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; color: #6B7280;">
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>零中间环节，流程更简洁</span>
          </li>
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>箭牌全权负责合同履行</span>
          </li>
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>无额外服务费用</span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 引荐工程 -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-4 mb-6">
        <div style="width: 56px; height: 56px; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #10B981; font-size: 1.5rem;">
          <i class="fas fa-users"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 8px;">引荐工程</h3>
          <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); color: #10B981; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">
            <i class="fas fa-percent"></i> 需支付服务费
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p style="color: #6B7280; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 24px;">
        由第三方作为中间方撮合达成购买意愿并签订合同的，且由第三方履行部分服务义务并对工程方的货款进行担保，因此箭牌需要支付一笔居间服务费给第三方。
      </p>
      <div style="background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px;">
        <h4 style="font-weight: 600; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <i class="fas fa-info-circle" style="color: #0499FD;"></i> 关键说明
        </h4>
        <ul style="list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; color: #6B7280;">
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>第三方须与箭牌签订服务商合同</span>
          </li>
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>享受按经销价购买产品权益</span>
          </li>
          <li style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0;">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            <span>服务费 = 工程合同 - 经销商金额</span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 两种模式对比 -->
<section style="margin-bottom: 48px; background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px;">
  <h2 style="font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;">
    <i class="fas fa-balance-scale" style="color: #0499FD;"></i>
    两种业务模式对比
  </h2>
  <p style="color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 24px;">传统经销商模式 vs 直签/引荐工程模式</p>
  
  <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
    <table class="table-custom" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: white; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="border-radius: 16px 0 0 0;">对比维度</th>
          <th>传统经销商模式</th>
          <th style="border-radius: 0 16px 0 0;">直营/引荐工程</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight: 600;">签约主体</td>
          <td>经销商与工程方签约</td>
          <td class="highlight">箭牌与工程方直接签约</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight: 600;">中间环节</td>
          <td>品牌 → 经销商 → 工程方</td>
          <td class="highlight">品牌 → 工程方（或经服务商）</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight: 600;">价格体系</td>
          <td>经销价分销</td>
          <td class="highlight">工程方单价 / 经销商单价</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight: 600;">服务费</td>
          <td>无</td>
          <td class="highlight">仅引荐工程：差额部分</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="font-weight: 600;">合同责任</td>
          <td>经销商承担</td>
          <td class="highlight">箭牌（或含服务商担保）</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 服务费计算规则 -->
<section style="margin-bottom: 48px;">
  <h2 style="font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;">
    <i class="fas fa-calculator" style="color: #0499FD;"></i>
    工程服务费计算规则
  </h2>
  
  <!-- 核心公式 -->
  <div class="formula-box" style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 32px;">
    <p style="color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 1.125rem;">工程服务费</p>
    <p style="font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: #2563EB; line-height: 1.2;">
      工程方金额 − 经销商金额
    </p>
    <p style="color: #6B7280; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.875rem;">
      <i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>
      即：工程合同金额与经销商金额的差额部分
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- 计算示例 -->
  <div style="background: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB;">
    <h3 style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
      <i class="fas fa-table" style="color: #0499FD;"></i>
      计算示例
    </h3>
    
    <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
      <table class="table-custom" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden;">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>产品</th>
            <th>数量</th>
            <th>工程方单价</th>
            <th>经销商单价</th>
            <th>工程方金额</th>
            <th>经销商金额</th>
            <th style="background: rgba(4,153,253,0.1); color: #0499FD;">工程服务费</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td style="font-weight: 600;">产品 A</td>
            <td>1,000</td>
            <td>¥2,400</td>
            <td>¥1,800</td>
            <td>¥2,400,000</td>
            <td>¥1,800,000</td>
            <td class="highlight">¥600,000</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td style="font-weight: 600;">产品 B</td>
            <td>800</td>
            <td>¥1,900</td>
            <td>¥1,499</td>
            <td>¥1,520,000</td>
            <td>¥1,199,200</td>
            <td class="highlight">¥320,800</td>
          </tr>
          <tr style="background: #F9FAFB;">
            <td style="font-weight: 700;">合计</td>
            <td>-</td>
            <td>-</td>
            <td>-</td>
            <td style="font-weight: 700;">¥3,920,000</td>
            <td style="font-weight: 700;">¥2,999,200</td>
            <td style="font-weight: 700; background: rgba(4,153,253,0.1);" class="highlight">¥920,800</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <!-- 数据卡片 -->
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-top: 32px;">
      <div style="background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center;">
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">工程合同总额</p>
        <p class="number-big" style="font-size: 2.5rem;">392<span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">万</span></p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center;">
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">经销商成本</p>
        <p class="number-big" style="font-size: 2.5rem;">300<span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">万</span></p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center;">
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">服务费收入</p>
        <p class="number-big" style="font-size: 2.5rem;">92<span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">万</span></p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0499FD 0%, #0284E8 100%); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center; color: white;">
        <p style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">服务费占比</p>
        <p style="font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900;">23.5<span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">%</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 业务流程图 -->
<section style="margin-bottom: 48px;">
  <h2 style="font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;">
    <i class="fas fa-project-diagram" style="color: #0499FD;"></i>
    服务费报销兑现流程
  </h2>
  <p style="color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 24px;">
    <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle" style="color: #F59E0B; margin-right: 4px;"></i>
    服务费在商品发出签收后开始计算，但必须在收到工程方货款后才能兑现给服务商
  </p>

  <!-- 阶段一：合同签订 -->
  <div style="margin-bottom: 32px;">
    <span class="phase-badge" style="margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block;">📝 第一阶段：合同签订</span>
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #2563EB; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">1</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">签订合同</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">确定销售产品清单，包含产品、工程方单价、工程方金额</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #2563EB; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">2</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">申请经销商折扣</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">确定产品的经销商价格</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #2563EB; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">3</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">创建要货订单</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">准备出货给工程方</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 阶段二：订单执行 -->
  <div style="margin-bottom: 32px;">
    <span class="phase-badge" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #059669 100%); margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block;">⚙️ 第二阶段：订单执行（系统流转）</span>
    <div style="background: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; margin-top: 16px;">
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px;">
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
          <div style="width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-cog" style="color: #2563EB; font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">CRM</span>
        </div>
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-right" style="color: #D1D5DB; font-size: 1.25rem;"></i>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
          <div style="width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-database" style="color: #8B5CF6; font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">ERP</span>
        </div>
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-right" style="color: #D1D5DB; font-size: 1.25rem;"></i>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
          <div style="width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-warehouse" style="color: #10B981; font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">WMS</span>
        </div>
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-right" style="color: #D1D5DB; font-size: 1.25rem;"></i>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
          <div style="width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-box" style="color: #F97316; font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">出库确认</span>
        </div>
        <i class="fas fa-arrow-right" style="color: #D1D5DB; font-size: 1.25rem;"></i>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
          <div style="width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-chart-line" style="color: #EF4444; font-size: 1.5rem;"></i>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;">EPMS</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top: 24px; padding: 16px; background: #F9FAFB; border-radius: 12px;">
        <p style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6B7280;">
          <i class="fas fa-info-circle" style="color: #0499FD; margin-right: 4px;"></i>
          流程说明：CRM → ERP创建出库单 → 抛转WMS发货 → 回传ERP出库确认 → 回传EPMS
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 阶段三：签收与报销 -->
  <div style="margin-bottom: 32px;">
    <span class="phase-badge" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B 0%, #D97706 100%); margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block;">📦 第三阶段：签收与报销</span>
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #D97706; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">4</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">工程方签收</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">工程方签收发货商品</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #D97706; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">5</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">服务商签收</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">服务商在系统进行签收操作</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #D97706; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">6</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">申请报销</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">对已签收商品做工程服务费报销申请</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <span style="width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #D97706; color: white; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700;">7</span>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 600;">工程方付款</h4>
        </div>
        <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">工程方付款至箭牌账户</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 阶段四：服务费兑现 -->
  <div style="margin-bottom: 32px;">
    <span class="phase-badge" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444 0%, #DC2626 100%); margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block;">💰 第四阶段：服务费兑现</span>
    <div style="background: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; margin-top: 16px;">
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 32px;">
        <!-- 左侧：认领货款 -->
        <div>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-hand-holding-usd" style="color: #10B981;"></i>
            货款认领
          </h4>
          <div class="flow-card">
            <p style="color: #6B7280; font-size: 0.875rem;">服务商对货款进行认领，即将收款和发货商品进行勾稽关联</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 右侧：兑现条件 -->
        <div>
          <h4 style="font-weight: 700; color: rgb(17,24,39); margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
            <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle" style="color: #EF4444;"></i>
            兑现必要条件
          </h4>
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;">
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.05); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.1);">
              <span style="width: 24px; height: 24px; background: #EF4444; color: white; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;">1</span>
              <p style="color: rgb(17,24,39); font-size: 0.875rem;">经销商已提交报销，即提供发票给箭牌</p>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.05); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.1);">
